definitions.population: all 1374 frozen clips before temporal sampling, including clips dropped by window protocols
definitions.weighting: frame/joint weighted percentages within split/activity; severe-clip percentage is clip weighted
definitions.severe_missingness: predeclared descriptive threshold: >25% of clip frames have >25% invalid joints
definitions.invalid_joint: unchanged preprocessing validity: confidence<0.1, nonfinite, or x=y=0
definitions.invalid_shoulder_scale: one/both raw shoulders invalid, nonfinite width, or width<=5 pixels; separate original implementation counter included
definitions.torso_fallback: unchanged _torso_scale branch, including its secondary valid-point-span/1.0 safeguards
definitions.interpolated_joints: all previously invalid joints filled by existing interpolate strategy; includes bounded interpolation and edge extension, excludes never-observed joints
definitions.gaps: run-count distribution split by bounded, leading/trailing edge and never-observed joint; no temporal resampling
